scoring_justification: The free-energy barriers require a full DFT+CHE protocol that the verifier sandbox cannot repeat; only the agent's reported final values are available. Therefore we compare the reported barriers to the paper's published values with tolerance and verify structural trends.

outputs.description: Free-energy barriers for the CO* → CHO* step on the four surfaces. Each value is a nonnegative float in eV.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker will compare the reported barriers to reference values with an appropriate tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference free-energy barriers for CO* → CHO* on Cu(100), Cu(110), Cu(111), CuPd(111) from the published paper (DOI:10.1016/j.comptc.2016.03.011).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and Fig. 2B: barriers 0.92 eV (Cu100), 0.62 eV (Cu110), 0.97 eV (Cu111), and 0.63 eV (Cu/Pd(111)).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported quantitative results.
